judgment.label: incorrect
judgment.mode_quote: Based on the provided evidence, there was a change in the number of Best Buy stores between Q2 of FY2024 and FY2023.
judgment.reason: Candidate says Best Buy stores fell from 930 (Q2 FY2023) to 907 (Q2 FY2024), but evidence table shows Best Buy only: 930 at end Q2 FY2023 and 907 at end Q2 FY2024 (matches candidate). However reference states 982 to 969 total stores with 1.32% decline; reference uses total Domestic segment stores while candidate uses Best Buy branded only. Reference and evidence conflict on store scope; candidate answered Best Buy-only not total, and reference expects total-store decline answer, so not agreeing with reference.
